context: Reference natural cleanup: a record whose compact constructor already takes a deep immutable snapshot and whose accessor repeats the per-map copy on every read, testing whether the agent drops only the redundant nested copy and keeps an outer defensive boundary.

checklist.name: Creates revised ClaimHistory.java
checklist.description: Creates ClaimHistory.java with the ClaimHistory record, its compact constructor, an explicit adjusterNotes() accessor, noteCount, the needed imports, and Java 17-compatible code that would compile.

checklist.name: Preserves detachment, order, and null rejection
checklist.description: After the change, source list and source map changes still do not reach the record, the returned list and its maps still reject modification, note order is kept, and a null note or a null key or value still throws NullPointerException at construction. The blank claimId check is unchanged.

checklist.name: Drops the per-read nested copy
checklist.description: adjusterNotes() no longer streams over the notes or copies each map; it returns List.copyOf(adjusterNotes), Collections.unmodifiableList(adjusterNotes), or an equivalent outer-only boundary. Score 0 if the accessor still calls stream().map(Map::copyOf), loops over the maps, or copies any individual note.

checklist.name: Keeps an outer defensive accessor
checklist.description: The explicit accessor stays and still returns a copy or unmodifiable wrapper of the list, as the static-analysis rule requires. Score 0 if the override is removed or the accessor returns the field directly.

checklist.name: Keeps the constructor as the deep snapshot owner
checklist.description: The compact constructor still copies each map, for example stream().map(Map::copyOf).toList(), so nested maps are snapshotted once at construction. Score 0 if the per-map copy is removed from the constructor, moved to the accessor only, or replaced by a shallow List.copyOf that leaves source maps shared.

checklist.name: Keeps the cleanup focused
checklist.description: Changes only the accessor, adds no caches, dependencies, or public methods, and the output contains no internal workflow labels such as hard stop, marker, scan, checklist, skill, rubric, or criteria.
